summary: Frontend-only exploratory bug hunt (PART A: invoicing/B2G/settings/UX) and HR verification (PART B). Login as demo@timologio.gr and office@koletsas.gr both work. All 25 sidebar routes return HTTP 200 (no 404s). Settings persistence works (verified by editing Δραστηριότητα, saving and reloading). Deep-link ?tab=... works for b2g/developer/audit/users/accountant/appearance. B2G invoice validation correctly disables submit and surfaces BT-11 rule. Mobile 390px layouts have no horizontal overflow. PART B HR passes core testids: office-employees-page, payroll-nav, employees-summary, staff-access-<id>, ergani-credentials + submit/test-connection + submissions-table + annex-info; staff portal PIN login + leave submit → success toast and Εκκρεμεί row. ERGANI LIVE creds (EFKA18828416 / UOS7BESUAX, mode=live) authenticate against production, resolve employer ANYHOW ΙΚΕ ΑΦΜ 802224910 Παράρτημα 0, and E4 submit returns a real ERGANI XSD 400 (not a 500/timeout). Found 12 defects — 2 HIGH (missing Payments and Notifications settings tabs; sample-data placeholder 'missing-field' leaking into an issued invoice), 4 MEDIUM (form testid coverage gaps, hydration warning, page title fallback, missing AFM mismatch warning toast), 6 LOW.

ui_bugs.issue: The task spec explicitly lists 'payments Stripe/Viva/IRIS' and 'notifications' as settings tabs, but neither exists. Deep-links ?tab=payments and ?tab=notifications silently fall back to the default 'Επιχείρηση' tab (no 404, no visible tab activation). Visible tabs today: Επιχείρηση, Τιμολόγηση, Εμφάνιση PDF, myDATA, Αναζήτηση ΑΦΜ (ΑΑΔΕ), Δημόσιο (B2G), Σειρές, Πεδία & κανάλια, Χρήστες, Λογιστής, Ηλ. αλληλογραφία, Διασυνδέσεις & API, Λογιστική ΕΛΠ, Εξαγωγή δεδομένων, Ιστορικό. Stripe/Viva/IRIS payment provider settings and per-user notification preferences appear to have no UI.

Line item description literally shows placeholder text 'Υπηρεσία B2G missing-field' on an ISSUED and DIAVIVASTHKE invoice. Either seed data is broken (recommended fix: rename to a real Greek description like 'Υπηρεσία B2G – παροχή') OR the code is falling back to a debug string when field is empty. Currently visible in production-like PDF and page.

Zero data-testid attributes on any form field: Σειρά select, Πελάτης combobox, Ημερομηνία έκδοσης, Προθεσμία πληρωμής, Τρόπος πληρωμής, Νόμισμα, Ποσότητα/Τιμή/ΦΠΑ line inputs, Έκδοση/Αποθήκευση ως πρόχειρο buttons. Only sidebar/nav testids exist. Blocks automated regression and violates the app-wide data-testid policy.

ui_bugs.component: Email dialog on invoice detail (Αποστολή email)
ui_bugs.issue: All fields inside the send-email dialog lack data-testid: recipient input (placeholder 'logistirio@pelatis.gr'), message textarea, Άκυρο/Αποστολή buttons. Additionally the dialog does not expose a visible Subject field, only recipient + free-text note.

Console warning on first render: 'A tree hydrated but some attributes of the server rendered HTML didn't match the client properties' — indicates SSR/client mismatch on the invoice editor (likely date/locale-based). Cosmetic in dev but pollutes error stream and can break progressive enhancement.

Several pages render the generic fallback <title>'Τιμολόγιο Cloud – Ηλεκτρονική Τιμολόγηση, CRM & myDATA'</title> instead of a route-specific title: /dashboard, /customers, /deadlines, /projects, /accountant, and invoice detail (/invoices/<id>). Bad for tab management and SEO/analytics.
The individual role='tab' buttons in /settings have no data-testid. Only the sidebar 'nav-settings' link is tagged. Makes deep-link/tab-switch testing brittle.

The B2G tab exposes Provider dropdown, Environment, enable toggles, Provider display name and Provider AFM — but NO field for a PEPPOL 'subscription key' (Access Point subscription key / API token). Task spec explicitly mentioned filling 'provider/subscription key'. If real providers (Softone, Retail@link, etc.) need per-tenant credentials, that flow is missing from the UI.

PART B spec requires a WARNING toast about AFM mismatch when the test connection succeeds (client demo AFM 800000118 vs employer AFM 802224910 returned by ERGANI). Only the neutral success/annex-info was rendered — no distinct warning toast surfaced in the DOM sonner stack during the test. If the intent is to warn the accountant not to submit against a mismatched AFM, the UI is silent.

After successful leave submission the success toast 'Το αίτημα υποβλήθηκε (2 εργάσιμες ημέρες).' is present twice in the DOM (duplicate toast). Non-critical but suggests either double action dispatch or a stacked toast that isn't dedup'd.

Multiple Failed-to-load 429 responses observed while doing a rapid sweep of ~25 sidebar routes (API_RATE_LIMIT=120 in /app/frontend/.env). A logged-in user opening the app quickly could hit this and see silent widget failures.
Multiple 'The resource ... was preloaded using link preload but not used within a few seconds from the window's load event' warnings on woff2 files. Wasted bandwidth and cluttered console.

action_items: HIGH: Add the missing Settings tabs the spec requires: Πληρωμές (Stripe/Viva/IRIS provider keys, webhook secrets, default payment method) and Ειδοποιήσεις (per-event email/browser preferences). Deep-links ?tab=payments and ?tab=notifications currently fall back silently to 'Επιχείρηση'.

HIGH: Fix the seeded invoice line description 'Υπηρεσία B2G missing-field' on ΤΠ-0007 (and any other invoice with that literal). Either update the seed to a real description or fix the fallback that renders the placeholder token.

MEDIUM: Add data-testid to every field on /invoices/new (series, customer, dates, currency, payment terms, line description, qty, unit price, discount, vat, actions) and to the Send-email dialog (recipient, subject, message, send-btn). Also add role=tab data-testid=`tab-<key>` to settings tabs.
MEDIUM: Investigate and fix the SSR/client hydration mismatch on /invoices/new (likely a date/locale-formatted default).

MEDIUM: Emit an explicit Sonner warning toast when ergani-test-connection succeeds but the resolved employer ΑΦΜ differs from the client's ΑΦΜ (spec: 'Συνδέθηκε: ANYHOW …' + warning about AFM mismatch).
MEDIUM: Set proper <title> per route for /dashboard, /customers, /deadlines, /projects, /accountant and /invoices/<id> (currently the global fallback).
LOW: B2G tab should expose an input for PEPPOL subscription key / access-point token so real providers can be onboarded (task spec mentioned provider/subscription key).
LOW: Dedup the leave-submit success toast (currently emitted twice in the DOM).
LOW: Loosen API_RATE_LIMIT=120 or scope it per-endpoint — a rapid nav sweep triggers 429s.
LOW: Remove unused font <link rel=preload> to silence console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Testability policy is unevenly applied: sidebar and payroll get full data-testid coverage, but the invoice editor form and every modal dialog (email, staff-access, employee-add) have none. Consider a lint/codemod that requires data-testid on <input>/<select>/<button> descendants of <form> and role=dialog.

Settings 'Πληρωμές' and 'Ειδοποιήσεις' tabs are referenced in product spec but absent from the UI — this is a scope gap, not a bug. Either update the spec or add the tabs (Stripe/Viva/IRIS keys are already in .env for Stripe, so the payments tab is the closest to shippable).

The 'missing-field' string on a seeded, issued and myDATA-diavivastheke invoice suggests either a seed bug or a dev-time fallback shipping to production data. Add a validator on invoice-issue that rejects any line description containing the token 'missing-field'/'TODO'/'placeholder'.

ergani-test-connection returns success even when the resolved employer AFM ≠ client AFM. This is a real risk in a multi-client accountant scenario — spec explicitly wants an AFM-mismatch warning toast. Add a client-side guard that blocks E4/E12/E3/E8 submit when AFM mismatches, or at least surfaces a bright warning.

React 19 hydration mismatch warning on /invoices/new: usually caused by rendering `new Date()` or `toLocaleString()` without a stable server value. Prefer setting the default date in a useEffect or pass a server-computed ISO string via props.
Duplicate success toast on leave submit implies either React strict mode double-invoke of an async action or a missing single-flight guard in the client action wrapper.
